contract.store_owner: The consumer borrows the caller's existing RuntimeWorldItemAdapterV1. It creates no world-item map, item manager, RNG, inventory, radius rule, or source ObjectManager receiver.
contract.enumeration: Each presentation row retains the exact stored RuntimeWorldItemRecordV1 (source ActorId, killer ActorId, loot table/entry, ItemTable ID/row, quantity, optional resolved gold value), stable store identity, position, source text OID, ItemTable IconName, ItemTable AudioVisualID and the mapped ItemAudioVisualTable name/Visual URI.
contract.interaction: Root passes a current selection returned by enumerate() to interact_selected(), which verifies its identity/record is still in this store and calls RuntimeWorldItemInteractionV1::dispatch_live_player. There is no nearest/radius search; the source caller must first reach the explicit ItemObject::Interact transfer branch. Existing exact pickup-type/equipment/gold checks remain authoritative.

source_mapping.item_table: The source ItemTable's AudioVisualID is record word21 (offset 0x54). The current rows have empty IconName, so no 2D icon is claimed.
source_mapping.item_audiovisual_table: AudioVisualID indexes the same original ItemAudioVisualTable row; its row name and Visual string are exposed without substitution.

item_object_asset.source: Original ItemObject::InitOnce at 0x3ECE80 loads this path and assigns the selected ItemAudioVisualTable Visual string as its source visual xref.
item_object_asset.existing_native_visual_receipt: port/level-world/reports/android-native-owner-tests/world-item-visual-cache-v2/receipt.json records PASS for 30 actual ItemAudioVisual xrefs against the parsed ItemDrops BRES scene.

native_test.coverage: Loads the original Loot, power, and ItemAudioVisual caches; selects a genuine same-seed table9 outcome containing Potion0 and GoldStack01; resolves the gold creation value using the same caller-owned LootRandom8 stream and explicit value-bonus input 0; publishes both exact records to one existing store; enumerates source metadata; atomically picks Potion0 into the same CharacterState; verifies a stale view cannot replay it; and credits the resolved GoldStack01 value then retires it from that same store.
native_test.boundary: This focused consumer test selects the authored table directly and does not compose a CombatSession death event, RuntimeDeathRewardsV1, or production source AddGold bonus-property provider.
